Replace the group columns of a specification

Source: R/groups.R
ysx_regroup.Rd

Removes every existing group setting from the dots of spec, then marks the columns in groups with group: true. Other dots settings are kept. The group columns are used by ysx_check_repeats() and ysx_check(). Use ysx_ungroup() to remove all groups.

Usage

ysx_regroup(spec, groups)

Arguments

spec

A loaded yspec object.

groups

A character vector naming one or more columns in spec.

Value

A yspec object with the new group columns. spec is not modified.
